meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Expert data processing specialist with intelligent DuckDB/Polars selection for maximum performance. Always includes numpy, never uses pandas, runs everything through uv. Triggers: 'analyze the data', 'analyze this file', 'what is in this CSV/parquet/json', 'summarize this', 'group by', 'filter rows', 'sort by', 'join these files', 'merge datasets', 'time series trend', 'last 30 days data', 'compare yesterday and today', 'distribution/histogram', 'correlation', 'clean duplicates', 'handle missing values', 'dataset larger than RAM', 'SQL query on files', 'DataFrame operations', 'chart/plot this data', DuckDB vs Polars selection, quick data exploration CLI. NOT for plain text/code inspection, configs, or tiny inline math.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 CSV、Parquet 等数据文件,完成汇总、筛选与关联统计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对数据文件想快速搞清规律和统计结果
copy.tagline_en: Analyze CSV, Parquet, and JSON files to summarize, filter, and join data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with data files and want quick insights without complex coding

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 uv 运行 Python 来处理数据文件：先用 numpy，绝不用 pandas；根据操作类型在 DuckDB 和 Polars 之间自动选择（例如过滤排序用 Polars，复杂 SQL 和聚合用 DuckDB），并给出处理时间和结果行数。
howto.when: 当你提到“分析数据”“这个 CSV 里有什么”“分组汇总”等关键词，或要求对 CSV/Parquet/JSON 文件做查询、筛选、排序、合并、画图时触发。

say.text: 分析这份 CSV，按类别统计总金额。
把这个 Parquet 里金额大于 100 的行筛出来。
say.note: Claude 会改用 Polars 进行高效筛选。

say.text: 对比昨天和今天的数据，画个趋势图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude processes data files by running Python via uv: always includes numpy, never uses pandas, and automatically picks DuckDB or Polars based on the operation (filtering/sorting → Polars; heavy SQL/aggregation → DuckDB). It also reports processing time and row counts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze data, inspect a CSV/Parquet/JSON file, or request querying, filtering, sorting, joining, or plotting on such files.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV and total the amounts by category.
say_en.note: Claude uses DuckDB to query the file directly and returns grouped totals.

say_en.text: Filter rows with amount greater than 100 in this Parquet.
say_en.note: Claude switches to Polars for efficient filtering.

say_en.text: Compare yesterday and today and plot a trend chart.
say_en.note: Claude includes matplotlib and visualizes the time trend.
